purpose: Evaluate, without human labels or decisions, whether a frozen ranking predicts future direct PubMed MeSH link emergence better than prevalence and structural baselines.

not_measured: truth or importance of a scientific relationship
absence of academic or non-academic knowledge

transitions.machine_gate: complete official T0 PubMed baseline and matching MeSH release are locally checksum-verified
eligible universe, formula source, parameters, predictions, and artifact hashes are sealed before T1
three subsequent annual PubMed baseline release identifiers exist
complete official T1 PubMed baseline and matching MeSH release are locally checksum-verified
all outcome, power, integrity, and metric rules below execute without overrides

t0_remote_inventory.evidence_scope: remote source identities only; zero readiness until every local byte and record count is sealed

t0_manifest.evidence_scope: locally sealed source identity and record counts; zero metric or scientific readiness

t0.matching_vocabulary: official MeSH descriptor release used by that baseline
required_identity: official source URL for every file

t1.source: official complete annual PubMed baseline three releases after T0
t1.matching_vocabulary: official MeSH descriptor release used by T1

t0_candidate_universe.entity: MeSH descriptors present in the sealed T0 vocabulary and citation baseline
t0_candidate_universe.pair_order: lexicographic descriptor UI with A less than C

required_before_t1: one score for every eligible pair
deterministic total ordering and tie policy

machine_outcomes.observation_window: direct MeSH co-indexing rows present in the complete T1 baseline but absent from the complete sealed T0 baseline; publication dates are reported but do not define database emergence
machine_outcomes.new_row_definition: a PMID plus the unordered T0 descriptor-UI pair is absent at T0 and present at T1
machine_outcomes.pre_existing_pmid_handling: included and counted separately because later indexing of an existing PMID is a database-link emergence, not evidence that the underlying scientific relationship is new

negative_label.name: no_observed_link_emergence_in_window
negative_label.claim_limit: This label describes one indexed observation window and is not evidence that a relationship or knowledge is absent.

censored_label.name: indeterminate_or_source_censored
conditions: one or two new co-indexed PMIDs
either T0 descriptor UI is retired, merged, or cannot be mapped uniquely at T1
source completeness or record reconciliation fails
a qualifying PMID is retracted before evaluation
censored_label.evaluation_action: exclude from primary metric denominator and report every exclusion reason and count

automatic_structural_diagnostics.role: artifact probes, not negative ground truth

cohorts.ontology_adjacent: all excluded immediate-parent siblings meeting the endpoint support rule
cohorts.degree_matched_distant: deterministic SHA-256 sample of cross-branch pairs matched into endpoint-support deciles

pre_registered_evaluation.pass_rule: Every source, integrity, power, primary-metric, and structural-diagnostic gate passes.
pre_registered_evaluation.fail_rule: Any evaluable primary-metric or structural-diagnostic gate fails.
pre_registered_evaluation.abstain_rule: Sources, prediction integrity, outcome integrity, or power are insufficient for the frozen test.
pre_registered_evaluation.multiple_testing: Only the sealed formula receives a verdict; later formulas require a new protocol and T0 prediction seal.

required_per_pair_trace: T1 outcome source rows when mature
blind_spots_required_in_every_release: knowledge not indexed by PubMed or MeSH

blockers: the three-release prospective outcome window has not matured
current_state.next_machine_action: Wait for three subsequent complete annual PubMed baseline release identifiers, then pin and locally seal the official T1 source before any outcome evaluation; do not revise the T0 formula, scores, or total order.
